Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1075121. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, and target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075121'. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
